simple.summary: יִפְתַּח־אֵל (Yiphtach-ʼêl) means Jiphtach-el , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 14.

definitions.full: H3317. Yiphtach -el יִפְתַּחאֵֿל proper name, of a location ( God openeth ; compare Sabean proper name, masculine יפתחאל Hal 148, l ); — in ׳גֵּייִפ ( Γαφαηλ, Γαι και Φθαιηλ A ᵐ5 L Γαι ( Ι ) εφθαηλ ), valley between Zebulun and Asher Josh 19:14 , 27 (P); probably near Jêfât ( Jotapata ), and perhaps upper part of Wady `Abellîn , see Buhl Geogr.109, 223 .
